section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a daily diary study examining personality, feelings, and body image. All participants were female undergraduate students recruited from psychology courses at a university, who completed online surveys via Qualtrics over an 8-day period. The study involved participants completing at least seven out of eight daily surveys administered between 4:00-11:00 pm each evening.
